mapper.select: SELECT e.*, d.name as department_name, d.description as department_description, u.username as username FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.name = e.name AND u.role = 'EMPLOYEE' ORDER BY e.id

SELECT e.*, d.name as department_name, d.description as department_description, u.username as username FROM employee e LEFT JOIN department d ON e.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.name = e.name AND u.role = 'EMPLOYEE' WHERE e.department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY e.id
